title: Introduce service claim quarantine and KMS callproof gateway for region-pin enforcement
author: Maya K. Patel
description: Motivation: Customers operating under strict data residency and operator segregation requirements asked for a lightweight enforcement layer that prevents cross-region operator actions and records provable key usage metadata at request time. This PR implements two cooperating pieces: 1) a service-claim quarantine mode in the RBAC v2 admission pipeline that temporarily blocks actions when operator/service claims are ambiguous or lack region binding, and 2) a KMS callproof gateway that attaches a signed, immutable KMS callproof header and emits a compact audit envelope for downstream ingestion. Design summary: The quarantine enforcer evaluates decision inputs from policy-compiler output and cross-references operator-scoped claims and the tenant region pin store. If claims do not conclusively bind to the tenant geozone, the request is quarantined and a deterministic auditing token is returned to the caller with an HTTP 409 and a guidance payload. The KMS callproof gateway signs a short SHA256 of the request metadata with a region-scoped ephemeral key and appends an X-Redwood-KMS-Proof header. Audit envelopes are produced in the new compact JSONL format to reduce volume and are forwarded to the audit-forwarder with a residency flag. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated (flags: rbac.quarantine.enabled, kms.callproof.gateway), staged canary on staging and a single EU prod region, opt-in config for Dedicated customers, 30% shadow mode for two weeks followed by enforcement. Backout: feature flags and a quick revert playbook included. Checklist: [x] Policy compiler adapters updated, [x] RBAC v2 decision cache integration, [x] KMS ephemeral key lifecycle management, [x] Audit envelope schema v2 implemented, [x] E2E test harness and CI smoke, [x] Docs and runbook added. Risks and mitigations: risk of false positives causing unnecessary 409s; mitigated by initial shadow runs and expanded decision logs; performance overhead from extra KMS callproof signing; mitigated by batching ephemeral key rotation and caching signatures per request group. Configuration knobs: quarantine_max_ttl_seconds, callproof_batch_size, residency_forwarding_topic. Testing: unit tests for policy edge cases, integration tests against the private-installer in a minikube mimic environment, load-tested callproof gateway at 5k RPS simulated with synthetic tenants. Related work: follows on top of ENG-3341 policy-compiler residency hints and SEC-189 KMS-scoped-keys work. Notes: This PR intentionally keeps the callproof payload minimal to avoid PII in audit streams; full request provenance can be retrieved by referencing the compact token and audit storage service.
